What FedEx Freight says to expect

  • Transition period to December 31, 2026: capital expendituresCapital expenditures for the four months ended September 30, 2026 were $151 million, and the company expects aggregate capital expenditures for the Transition Period (June 1 through December 31, 2026) to total approximately $365 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 29, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
